note: The supported spell is cast by a totem that stands where it was put, using the character's numbers, a little slower and a little weaker.

def.name: Standing Cast
def.description: A totem casts the spell for you.

note: The supported ranged attack is fired by up to three ballista totems, each slower and weaker than the character.

def.name: Standing Bow
def.description: Up to three bow totems fire the attack.

note: The supported skill is thrown as a trap that goes off when an enemy steps close, faster to throw and a little stronger.

def.name: Set Snare
def.description: The skill is thrown as a trap.

note: The supported skill is laid as mines that stand five seconds and go off in a chain, a quarter second apart, each dealing 5% more than the one before it; each deals less.

def.name: Chained Charges
def.description: The skill is laid as mines that set one another off.

note: The supported skill is laid as mines that stand five seconds; each mine gives the hits against the enemies near it a 2% chance to deal double damage (they add up); the skill deals less.

def.name: Heavy Charge
def.description: The skill is laid as a mine whose aura makes the hits near it land doubly now and then.

note: Three traps are thrown at once, each weaker.

def.name: Snare Cluster
def.description: Throws three traps at once.

note: Five mines are laid at once, much slower and each at the usual strength.

def.name: Field of Charges
def.description: Lays five mines at once, but takes much longer to do it.

note: Three traps are thrown at once, each weaker.

def.name: Triple Snare
def.description: Throws three traps at once.

note: Three totems stand at once, each weaker.

def.name: Totem Choir
def.description: Three totems stand at once.

note: More damage for traps and mines, thrown a little slower.

def.name: Wired Harm
def.description: Traps and mines hit harder, at a slower pace.

note: Traps are thrown faster and their stored uses come back faster; the effects the trap makes last longer (not the time the trap waits).

def.name: Swift Snares
def.description: Throws traps faster, and their uses return sooner.

note: A trap or mine often comes with an extra one (modelled as one more at a time, at a small price in damage).

def.name: Double Set
def.description: Traps and mines come in pairs.

note: Traps that go off may grant Insight or Fervour charges; Insight raises their critical multiplier.

def.name: Livewire Snares
def.description: Traps that go off may grant charges.

note: Mines that go off may grant Insight or Fervour charges; Insight raises their critical chance.

def.name: Livewire Charges
def.description: Mines that go off may grant charges.

note: A totem that flings fire at the enemies near it; the projectiles pierce everything.

def.name: Pyre Totem
def.description: Sets a totem that flings fire at enemies near it.

note: A totem that sends out a shockwave of force around itself, for eight seconds.

def.name: Quake Totem
def.description: Sets a totem that sends shockwaves out around itself.

note: A pair of totems that cast beams of fire at the character and at each other: what stands in a beam, or near either end of one, burns (damage over time that does not stack between beams). The totem does not hit.

def.name: Cinder Bond
def.description: Sets totems that burn everything in the beams between them and you.

note: A totem that strikes the enemies near it with the character's weapon; it is active only while the character is within about eight tiles of it, and while it is the character attacks faster.

def.name: Guardian Cairn
def.description: Sets a totem that strikes enemies beside it with your weapon and quickens you while you are near.

note: A totem that slams the ground beside it with the character's weapon; it is active only while the character is within about eight tiles of it, and while it is the character's melee damage is higher.

def.name: Slamming Cairn
def.description: Sets a totem that slams the ground beside it and strengthens your blows while you are near.

note: Ballista totems (up to three, standing eight seconds, attacking at half speed) that fire six arrows into the air; they come down in a line toward the target and each bursts where it lands.

def.name: Mortar Bow
def.description: Sets bow totems that lob arrows to burst along the ground.

note: Up to three ballista totems that fire piercing arrows with the character's bow.

def.name: Lance Bow
def.description: Sets bow totems that shoot long, piercing arrows.

note: Ballista totems (up to three, standing eight seconds, attacking at half speed) that fire a cone of arrows with added physical damage; an enemy can be hit by several of the arrows of one shot (one of two skills that can).

def.name: Scatter Bow
def.description: Sets bow totems that scatter arrows; close up, several arrows of one shot hit the same enemy.

note: A totem whose aura regenerates life for eight seconds (modelled as a guard buff cast when hurt).

def.name: Mending Totem
def.description: Sets a totem whose aura mends you.

note: Sets a totem for eight seconds that the enemies around it go for instead of the character; it has life of its own and deals no damage.

def.name: Lure Totem
def.description: Sets a totem that enemies go for instead of you.

note: A trap (four seconds, stored three uses of a four-second cooldown) that crushes the enemy that steps in it and holds it for as long as its hit was a share of the enemy's life, then leaves it shackled: slow, fading, and taking 15% more from traps and mines.

def.name: Jaws Trap
def.description: A trap that bites the enemy that steps in it and holds it in place, then leaves it shackled.

note: A trap that bursts into a fire that burns the area for almost two seconds.

def.name: Blaze Trap
def.description: A trap that sets the ground alight.

note: A trap that bursts into a cold blast.

def.name: Frost Trap
def.description: A trap that freezes the air around it.

note: A trap that blasts in fire and then in several smaller blasts (modelled as repeats).

def.name: Shrapnel Trap
def.description: A trap that blasts again and again.

note: A trap that breathes fire for three and a half seconds.

def.name: Fire Breath Trap
def.description: A trap that breathes fire, harder on the burning.

note: A trap that raises a spire that strikes the enemies near it with lightning for three and a half seconds.

def.name: Spire Trap
def.description: A trap that raises a spire of lightning.

note: A trap that bursts into a ring of lightning bolts, with a chance to shock.

def.name: Bolt Trap
def.description: A trap that sends lightning in every direction, and crits the shocked more often.

note: A trap that sends a line of five physical eruptions in front of it.

def.name: Rumble Trap
def.description: A trap that makes the ground erupt in a line.

note: A trap with a four-second cooldown: it ties beams to the ten nearest enemies for three seconds, chilling them and burning them with cold; the character regains life and mana a second, a flat amount while any is held and more for each.

def.name: Drain Trap
def.description: A trap whose beams drain the enemies near it: cold damage over time for them, life and mana for you.

note: A mine that shoots five icicles when it goes off.

def.name: Icicle Charge
def.description: A mine that throws icicles when it goes off.

note: A mine (standing five seconds, set off with the rest of its set) that bursts in fire and then rains two more, smaller bursts around it, one more for every two mines that went off before it; the mines near an enemy add fire damage to the hits against it.

def.name: Mortar Charge
def.description: A mine that lobs fire when it goes off, and more fire after.

note: A mine that bursts in a storm when it goes off; enemies near the mines take 3% more damage from each, up to 150%.

def.name: Storm Charge
def.description: A mine that bursts in a storm when it goes off.

note: Throws a mine and goes to it the moment it goes off: the character gets away to the safest spot in reach when it is hurt or a pack has closed in; smoke at both ends blinds what stands in it, and a speed buff follows. The blink skills share a cooldown.

def.name: Smoke Charge
def.description: Throws a mine and goes to it, leaving smoke that blinds, and quickens you.

note: A brand that attaches to an enemy and pulses fire around it every three-quarters of a second, with a strong ignite.

def.name: Doom Sigil
def.description: A sigil that burns the enemy it is on and the ones near it.

note: A brand that attaches to an enemy and chains lightning from it to others near, every 0.6 seconds.

def.name: Tempest Sigil
def.description: A sigil that arcs lightning from the enemy it is on to its neighbours.
